meta.title: WoW Forever Mage spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (wowsims's generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to the rank's wowsims_overrides: those fields are wowsims's in-game measurements, not client rows)
source.vanilla: cmangos classic-db spell_template (1.12) for vanilla_* fields, npc_trainer_template 81 + npc_trainer rows of class 8 trainers for vanilla_trainer (teach spell -> learned spell through effect 36 LEARN_SPELL)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount is floored.
formulas.cost: cost.mana flat; cost.pct_base_mana = pct of base mana (base_mana table in <class>_levels.json); cost.rage in rage (row value / 10); cost.energy; cost.combo_points_min = the finisher needs at least that many; cost.health (Life Tap row has none: wowsims spends amount + Spirit).
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank (client). learned_from.vanilla_trainer gives the vanilla 1.12 trainer level and cost for comparison. 2 Nov notes: training every class ability 1-60 costs 206-207 gold in Forever, so vanilla costs are not Forever costs.
formulas.vanilla_compare: vanilla.changes_vs_vanilla compares learn level, flat cost, cooldowns and each effect's amount at the learn level (vanilla BasePoints+1 .. BasePoints+DieSides, Forever tooltip range) with the 1.12 row of the same id. A difference of 1 point or less is ignored. Cast times and durations are not compared (the 1.12 rows store index ids into tables not in the local data).
formulas.required_stance_mask: client StanceMask bit field (1 << (form id - 1)); e.g. warrior Battle 17, Defensive 18, Berserker 19; druid Cat 1, Bear 5, Dire Bear 8, Moonkin 31.

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or a downrank coefficient penalty. Ranks learned below 20 carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty so a sim can switch the vanilla rule on.
coefficient_penalties.forever_notes: kami-labs summary of the 2 Nov 2026 notes: the low-rank penalty was removed from several chance-based talents and stays on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (proc less often when the rank was learned more than 12 levels below the caster). Nothing in the notes speaks to damage/heal coefficients of low ranks.

forever_class_notes: Frostfire Bolt baseline at 40; Mage Armor's spirit regen bonus increased; Cone of Cold shorter (deep dive 7 Oct). 2 Nov notes: Arcane Blast stack cost +100%; downrank penalty kept on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost procs (rank learned 12+ levels below the caster).
notes_sources: Warcraft Tavern summaries of Blizzard's Forever class deep dives: Priest & Warrior (1 Oct 2026, Blizzard news 24301514), Mage & Shaman (7 Oct, 24302097), Rogue & Warlock (7 Oct, 24310968); 'All Changes to Paladins' (21 Sep 2026); 'WoW Forever Pre-Launch Class Changes & Bug Fixes' (4 Nov 2026, from Kaivax's Beta Development Notes updated 2 Nov).
Blizzard news 'World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives - Hunter and Druid' (news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301515).
kami-labs 'WoW Forever November 2 patch: 223 changes before launch' (datamined items marked).
The Blizzard forum dev-notes thread itself could not be fetched here (needs approval); its content is taken from the summaries above.
Where a note and a client row disagree, the row wins; the row values are the ones in ranks[].

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Only the highest rank is registered: the mage casts the rank configured here, not every rank spellData.Blizzard lists. Each tick casts the same rank of spellData.BlizzardTriggered on every enemy in the area, and rolls a crit unless the tick's row bars it. The cast's row names no tick spell, only an area trigger, so the two pair by rank.

"Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%." It procs on the hit and is spent by the next cast. Arcane Missiles rolls it once as the channel starts and again as each missile lands (the missile's row carries Not a Proc, so the listener hears it), all under the row's 1 sec cooldown.

Cold Snap https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=12472 "Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells." The row's effect is a dummy, so "Frost spells" is read as the school: Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Block and Ice Barrier. A cooldown a spell of another school also runs on is left alone, so Frost Ward, which shares category 56 with Fire Ward, is not reset.

Combustion https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=11129 "When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells." Two auras: 11129 counts the crits left in its stacks (its ProcCharges), and 28682 carries the crit, a SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE per stack on its own class mask, up to 10 stacks. Effect 2 casts 28682 on activation, so the crit starts at one stack before any Fire hit. The row is Disabled While Active (Attr0 0x2000000): the cooldown starts when the effect ends. Each landed Fire spell hit adds a stack, a crit included; a crit then spends one of the charges. Periodic damage never reaches OnSpellHitDealt, so DoT ticks and Ignite neither stack nor spend, and a Fire wand's shots are ranged autos, not spells. An off-GCD cast of its own.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Frigid Power, the Frost damage buff every Ice Barrier cast applies. No effect of Ice Barrier names it; its tooltip does ("$1326891s1%"). Only the highest rank is registered: the mage casts the rank configured here, not every rank spellData.IceBarrier lists. Ice Barrier https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=13033 "Shield yourself, absorbing ${$s1+($SPFR*0.1)*($11189s3/100+1)} damage and increasing your Frost damage by $1326891s1% for $d. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional $s2% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage." The shield's effects 2 and 3 raise Frost damage while it holds, and Frigid Power raises it again for the full minute, however soon the shield breaks. The spell power share is the tooltip's, since the row states no coefficient, and Frost Warding's effect 3 raises the whole absorb. The sim models no pushback, so the casting time clause does nothing. The spell power a Frost spell reads ($SPFR in a tooltip): the general bonus plus the Frost one.

Ice Block https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=11958 "You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells." The row's stun (effect 1) is core's stun aura, which stops the mage casting; its two school immunities (effects 2 and 3, every school between them) zero the damage taken while it is up. Being core's stun, its duration also takes the mage's StunDurationMultiplier, which nothing a mage wears changes.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Only the highest rank is registered: the mage casts the rank configured here, not every rank spellData.Flamestrike lists. The burn is its own spell (MageSpellFlamestrikeDot) on the cast's row, tagged like Fireball's DoT so the two share a header: every 2 sec it deals the same rank of spellData.FlamestrikeTriggered to each enemy in the area, and rolls a crit unless the tick's row bars it. The cast's row names no tick spell, only an area trigger, so the two pair by rank. In game each ground tick is a hit of the tick spell, so a talent that listens for hits rolls on it once a tick, however many enemies it hits; here the ticks are periodic damage, and Arcane Concentration forwards them to its hit listener.
